1. Ran `sh /cells.sh` exactly once. The script exited with code 0; all 12 file operations it attempted failed with “Read-only file system.” 2. Submitted all 12 patches exactly as given, in order, with one `apply_patch` call per patch. Every patch was rejected by the read-only sandbox and approval settings. 3. Used `apply_patch` once to attempt to create `

/hoh-tool-create` containing the single line `hoh-cell`. The operation was rejected by the same restrictions. 4. Successfully read `

/TOKEN.txt`. 5. Reported the results here. No failed operation was retried or worked around. ```hoh-decisions {"nonce": "spike", "message": {"token": "HOH-TOKEN-220459aac1121adf"}} ```
